## Purpose

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Changes

Summarize the focused change. For research, link the precise sources and explain dating or attribution changes.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results, including anything you could not verify. Include screenshots for visible changes.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and the Code of Conduct.
- [ ] I checked the formatting of changed files.
- [ ] I ran the checks relevant to this change, or explained why I could not.
- [ ] Research changes preserve IDs, citations, date provenance, and the regenerated catalog, if applicable.
- [ ] New third-party material includes its source, credits, and reuse terms, if applicable.
- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, private data, databases, or browser state.
